scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && wrangler dev --config cloudflare/worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.check:worker: node --check server.js && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config cloudflare/worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config cloudflare/worker.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name shop-gallery
